Good news — as a Thai citizen you don't need a visa for a 30-day trip to Vietnam. Thailand has a bilateral visa-free agreement with Vietnam allowing stays of up to 30 days, so your exact 30-day trip fits right at the limit (no extra buffer if your trip runs even a day long — plan your exit date carefully).

Key details:
- Pathway: Visa-free entry (bilateral agreement with Thailand)
- Max stay: 30 days — matches your planned length exactly
- Cost: None
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date

If you ever want more flexibility (longer stay or a cushion beyond 30 days), Vietnam's e-Visa is available to all nationalities, including Thai citizens, for up to 90 days at USD 25 (single-entry) or USD 50 (multiple-entry), applied for at evisa.gov.vn.

This data is current as of 2026-08-17 — I'd recommend double-checking at evisa.gov.vn before you travel in case policy has changed.
